subject: Supplier invoice ingress: portal enrollment vs SMTP envelope + minimal CSV fields

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Acme activation — invoice delivery options and sample invoice

Hi Jordan and Vanessa,

Thanks for starting the vendor activation for Acme Paper Co. — quick question on how Redwood prefers to receive invoices for new suppliers. Our billing system can do either:

- Enroll into a vendor portal (we can push invoices via API / SFTP)
- Continue sending via SMTP to a dedicated mailbox (we can include a canonical subject token and lightweight CSV or PDF attachments)

I attached a recent sample invoice (PDF) and a one-row CSV export of the invoice fields we can generate. Can you confirm which path you want us to use for go‑live? If you prefer SMTP, what subject-token or minimum CSV columns do you need so your ingestion will match?

Attachments: acme_sample_invoice_0427.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), acme_sample_csv_layout.csv (CSV, 1KB)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

—Samir

Hi Samir — thanks for the samples, and welcome.

Short answers up front: we strongly prefer portal/API enrollment for ongoing suppliers (better idempotency, PO linking, and lower manual effort). That said, we accept SMTP envelopes for a short overlap period while portal access is being provisioned.

If you need to start via SMTP for 1–2 invoices during onboarding, please:
- Send to billing@redwoodinference.com
- Include subject token: REDW-ACME-<vendor-id> (we can map vendor-id later)
- Attach one CSV (single-line per invoice) OR a PDF invoice. If CSV, the minimal columns we require are: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, po_number (optional but preferred), currency (ISO), supplier_tax_id

For portal/API enrollment, our onboarding form (linked below) is the fastest. If you can produce the CSV in the attached layout it will make the onboarding validation trivial.

I copied Vanessa who handles the vendor intake flow and Kimberly for the CSV schema confirmation.

Next step: Vanessa, can you confirm the portal SSO timeline? Kimberly, can you confirm the minimal CSV header set we should require for SMTP backstop?

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jordan — portal sounds good long term. We can start with SMTP this week while Acme's portal account is provisioned.

We will:
- Send first invoices to billing@redwoodinference.com with subject: REDW-ACME-9987

Note: our CSV currently exports the following columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, total_amount, currency, po_number, line_item_summary, supplier_tax_id, billing_address. If you want a compact export we can drop due_date and billing_address and only emit the minimal set.

Subject: Internal: Acme onboarding — decide minimal CSV and portal timing

Vanessa / Kimberly,

Recap and asks from vendor (see thread below): Acme can do portal but needs a short SMTP overlap; will send with subject token REDW-ACME-9987 and attach one-line CSV + PDF for the first cycles.

Please confirm two items so I can reply and lock go‑live: 
1) Portal provisioning ETA — can we have Acme enrolled in the vendor portal (SSO + API access) by 2027-05-18? If not, what is realistic?
2) CSV schema — recommend we require a compact set for SMTP fallback to ensure automated ingest. My suggestion (compact required): invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, currency, supplier_tax_id, po_number (optional). Optional columns we can accept: line_item_summary, due_date.

Risks: if they omit supplier_tax_id we will need manual reconciliation for tax jurisdiction; if currency missing we default to USD and that introduces more friction.

If both items are a go, I'll tell Samir to start SMTP on Monday and we will mark the vendor as "portal pending" in the intake tracker. If portal ETA slips beyond 2027-05-18 we should require two test invoices via SMTP to validate ingestion.

Kimberly — can you confirm the minimal header ordering and any required formatting (e.g., date format enforcement) so I can send a crisp spec back to Samir?

Thanks,

Jordan
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
